The Travelling Informant

Leti is a young noblewoman who has been called cursed and confined to her room in the manor she lives in. But just as Leti is set to be married off in an unwanted marriage, a mysterious group called The Traveling Informants appears and puts a stop to it. Granted her freedom by the mysterious people, Leti sets off on a journey with them to learn more about the world. What will she see, and what will she gain? That all depends on her!
